description.zh: 账户展示名前缀，采用左匹配查询。
description.en: The display name prefix. A left-match query is used.
The email address of the account.
The number of entries per page for paging.

description.zh: 列表大小，默认20，最大不超过100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.
The phone number of the account.

description.zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +。
description.en: The phone region code. Example: The region code for the Chinese mainland is 86, without the 00 or + prefix.

description.zh:
账户状态，取值可选范围：
- enabled： 启用中。
- disabled： 禁用中。
description.en:
The account status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.

description.zh:
外部ID，用于外部数据与IDaaS账户的数据关联映射。

说明：外部ID在同一来源类型和来源ID下唯一。
description.en:
The external ID, which is used to associate external data with IDaaS accounts.

Note: The external ID must be unique within the same source type and source ID.

description.zh:
账户来源ID。

自建类型默认为实例ID，其他类型，分别对应不同来源的企业ID，比如钉钉来源对应钉钉企业的corpId。
description.en:
The source ID of the account.

For self-built accounts, the default value is the instance ID. For other types, the value corresponds to the enterprise ID of the respective source. For example, for a DingTalk source, the value corresponds to the corpId of the DingTalk enterprise.

description.zh:
账户来源类型，取值可选范围：
- build\_in：自建。
- ding\_talk：钉钉导入。
- ad：AD导入。
- ldap：LDAP导入
- we\_com：企业微信导入。
description.en:
The source type of the account. Valid values:
- build\_in: self-built.
- ding\_talk: imported from DingTalk.
- ad: imported from AD.
- ldap: imported from LDAP.
- we\_com: imported from WeCom.

description.zh: 账户名前缀，采用左匹配查询。
description.en: The username prefix. A left-match query is used.

descriptions.zh: 当前接口仅查询组织的直属权限，即直接分配给组织的应用。调用该接口时，可以通过 **ApplicationIds** 参数对应用进行筛选。
descriptions.en: This operation queries only the direct permissions of an organizational unit, which are the applications directly assigned to the organizational unit. When you call this operation, you can use the **ApplicationIds** parameter to filter applications.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam list-users --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --user-ids user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --username-starts-with name_001 --display-name-starts-with name --phone-region 86 --phone-number 156xxxxxxx --email user@example.com --user-external-id id_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --user-source-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --user-source-type build_in --status enable --organizational-unit-id ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --next-token NTxxxxexample --max-results 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam ListUsers --region cn-hangzhou --UserSourceType build_in --Status enable --UserIds.1 user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --Email 'user@example.com' --PageSize 20 --NextToken NTxxxxexample --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --UsernameStartsWith name_001 --MaxResults 20 --OrganizationalUnitId ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --PageNumber 1 --DisplayNameStartsWith name --PhoneNumber 156xxxxxxx --UserSourceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --UserExternalId id_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --PhoneRegion 86 --method POST --force
